# ── KITCHEN SINK: every surface construct Ever currently has ──
# Companion to 0-atom-c/kitchen_sink.c. That file tests the runtime;
# this one tests the LANGUAGE, written in the language.

# ── data types: one binding of each ──
let i_zero    = 0
let i_neg     = -42
let i_big     = 1000000
let r_half    = 0.5
let t_empty   = ""
let t_words   = "Ever"
let b_true    = true
let b_false   = false
ever unknown  = z

# ── arithmetic, including identities and zero ──
ever add_id   = i_big + 0
ever mul_id   = 42 * 1
ever mul_zero = 42 * 0
ever sub_self = 42 - 42
ever div_real = 1 / 2

# ── every comparison operator, at and around equality ──
ever lt_true  = 3 < 9
ever lt_eq    = 3 < 3
ever gt_true  = 9 > 3
ever gte_eq   = 3 >= 3
ever lte_eq   = 3 <= 3
ever eq_neg   = -1 == -1
ever neq_true = 3 != 9

# ── functions: arity one, two, and composition ──
def square(n)   = n * n
def diff(a, b)  = a - b
def inc(n)      = n + 1
def dec(n)      = n - 1

ever sq        = square(7)
ever order     = diff(50, 8)
ever order_rev = diff(8, 50)
ever composed  = square(inc(dec(7)))
ever chained   = inc(inc(inc(inc(38))))

# ── branching: literal, expression, and nested on both arms ──
ever br_lit    = if b_true then 42 else 0
ever br_expr   = if 10 > 5 then 6 + 36 else 0
ever br_mixed  = if b_false then 1 else 99   # both arms numeric — real type discipline
ever br_nest_t = if true then (if false then 1 else 42) else 0
ever br_nest_e = if false then 1 else (if true then 42 else 2)

# ── recursion at the depth ceiling and one step past it ──
def fact(n) = if n <= 1 then 1 else n * fact(n - 1)
ever f1 = fact(1)
ever f2 = fact(2)
ever f3 = fact(3)
ever f4 = fact(4)

show i_zero
show i_neg
show r_half
show t_empty
